profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A full stack software engineer that loves building intuitive, functional and reliable user experiences. I enjoy thinking through end-to-end solutions and have built APIs, SDKs, and component libraries for technical users. 

I value collaboration, diversity, mentorship and am always looking for opportunities to grow and challenge myself.

When I’m not building web applications, you’ll find me crafting, DIY-ing or hanging out at the park with my two dogs!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Selected to join a pilot team to build a new software suite from the ground up, contributed to building a new SDK and component library, led front-end architecture discussions to define API and UI contracts and delivered pilot project six months after meeting on-site.

• Orchestrated a customer hackathon, established accounts in preparation, contributed to feature documentation, and wrote troubleshooting guides, which provided meaningful product feedback while continually working on the private beta product release.

• Engineered Twilio Flex's v2 landing page from start to finish, collaborated with designers and product managers to scope and define requirements, delivered a light and dark mode experience, added unit and integration tests, and updated e2e test suites to support both v1 and v2 landing page views.

• Pioneered an 'Inclusive Terminology' initiative to remove historically oppressive terms, changed the team's repos from 'master' to 'main' branch, and updated Jenkins jobs, release pipelines, and service code to support the terminology rename.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Delivered endpoints on a product API that supported the developer user experience of creating and updated plugins, plugin versions and releases on Twilio Flex. 

• Established API monitoring and alerts, scheduled Runscope tests, configured CPS monitoring for rate limiting, built Datadog dashboards, added logging with MDC, onboarded logs to Rollbar and BigQuery, and maintained a 90%+ test coverage threshold. 

• Added new UI components and features to customer-facing dashboards that handled the enabling and disabling of customer assets, updated state management to React Redux, integrated with APIs, and wrote unit, integration and cluster tests.

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice
positions.description:
• Migrated two web pages that handled account and billing settings, changed all HTTP requests to GraphQL queries, and added GraphQL schemas server-side to support fetching and updating account configurations and billing plans.

• Introduced TypeScript and Redux to new Twilio Console pages, added pagination, error handling, and new UI components, including modals, tables, and alert banners, and owned the release strategy from development to production.
